🎓 Full Experience of Education Resources & Lifestyle Quality

  • Evening: Wrap-up seminar — individual consultation time to tailor your investment plan
Day 5 — Return with Confidence

✈️ Cape Town → Taiwan

  • Morning: Free time / individual property revisits (for clients who have identified specific targets)

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about the business tour

Do I need a visa for South Africa?
Taiwan passport holders enjoy 90-day visa-free travel to South Africa for tourism. The Premium package includes visa processing service to ensure your documents are in order.
Can I join if I don't speak English?
Absolutely! Full-time Mandarin interpretation is provided throughout the entire tour. All site visits and meetings include professional interpretation — no need to worry about language barriers.
How often is the tour held?
We run one business tour per quarter, limited to 10 participants per group to ensure everyone receives ample individual consultation time. Please contact our advisor for the latest departure dates.
Do I have to buy a property after the tour?
Not at all. The tour's purpose is to let you experience the South African market firsthand. All decisions are entirely yours after you have full information. We provide insights and professional advice but never apply pressure to buy.
Can I bring my family?
Spouses and family members are welcome! We have specially designed activities for accompanying family, so while you're on tour, your loved ones can also enjoy Cape Town's cuisine, scenery, and cultural experiences.
